kashika: पुंसि संज्ञायां करणाधिकरणयोश्चेति सर्वमनुवर्तते। हलन्ताद् धातोः करणाधिकरणयोर्घञ् प्रत्ययो भवति। घस्यापवादः। लेखः। वेदः। वेष्टः। बन्धः। मार्गः। अपामार्गः। वीमार्गः॥
kashikaEnglish: घञ् after consonant-final roots for masculine instrument/location appellative: लेखः 'writing', वेदः 'Veda', बन्धः 'bond', मार्गः 'way', रामः 'Rama' (where devout delight).
englishFull:
हलश्च — The affix घञ् applies after consonant-ending roots (when the word is masculine, related as instrument or location, and palatals change to gutturals).

This excludes घ.

| Example | Meaning |
|---------|---------|
| लेखः | writing (that in which something is inscribed) |
| वेदः | the Veda (that by which all is known) |
| वेशः | dress (that which is entered into) |
| बन्धः | obstruction |
| मार्गः | way (that on which they seek) |
